sourceAttempts.result: SCDNR lists Fort Mill, Rock Hill River Park, Landsford Canal State Park and SC 9 in upstream-to-downstream order, with approximately 7, 17 and 6 river-mile spacing and public water access descriptions.

The official park FAQ publishes a 1,000 cfs low guard, approximately 1,800–3,000 cfs practical downstream range, and expert-only review above 4,000 cfs; it also documents Lake Wylie release changes and shoal hazards.
Used direct Catawba telemetry at 02146000 near Rock Hill for the upper chain and 02147020 below Catawba for the Landsford-to-SC 9 corridor.

Fort Mill and Rock Hill municipal access pages plus SCDNR and the official canoe-trail guide support named water-entry facilities. Each route has same-river Landsford Canal context imagery from Wikimedia Commons.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: Park guidance is a conservative planning cue for the named scenic-river chain; releases, shoals, weather, debris and access conditions remain controlling.
